paper.title: Memory-assisted decoder for approximate Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill codes

blocks.original_text: Multiple rounds of syndrome extraction are combined with Bayesian estimation.
blocks.translation: 多轮 syndrome 信息用于 Bayesian 估计。

blocks.original_text: The physical protocol is based on Glancy-Knill recovery and a final correction.
blocks.translation: 物理协议基于 Glancy-Knill recovery，并在多轮后做末端纠正。

blocks.original_text: Sequential q-SE and p-SE produce measurement- and error-dependent shifts under a small-displacement approximation.
blocks.translation: 小位移近似下，q-SE/p-SE 产生由观测和误差共同决定的位移。

blocks.original_text: The h-round shift is separated into unknown error and known measurement-induced contributions.
blocks.translation: h 轮末端位移分成未知误差项和已知观测诱导项。
式 (7) 给出末端位移的误差项与 measurement-step 项分解。

blocks.original_text: The expected displacement remains bounded in the paper's model without per-round active correction.
blocks.translation: 在论文模型内，不逐轮主动纠正时的期望位移仍有界。

blocks.original_text: The decoder assumes a characterised channel with known sigma_0.
blocks.translation: 解码器假设通道已表征且 sigma_0 已知。

blocks.original_text: Eq. (9): posterior is proportional to likelihood times Gaussian prior.
blocks.translation: 式 (9) 的 posterior 由 likelihood 与 Gaussian prior 相乘得到。

blocks.original_text: All M outcomes enter the multiround posterior.
blocks.translation: 全部 M 个观测进入多轮 posterior。

blocks.original_text: Eq. (12): the q posterior is a product of M comb likelihoods and M Gaussian priors.
blocks.translation: 式 (12) 把 M 轮 likelihood 和 Gaussian prior 联合起来。

blocks.original_text: A multivariate Gaussian approximation yields a posterior-mean MMSE correction.
blocks.translation: multivariate Gaussian 近似给出 posterior-mean MMSE 纠正量。

blocks.original_text: The numerical result is tied to a selected finite-energy GKP parameter set.
blocks.translation: 数值结果绑定于选定的有限能 GKP 参数组。

blocks.original_text: The conclusion is limited to the studied recovery and displacement model.
blocks.translation: 结论只适用于所研究的 recovery 与位移模型。

blocks.original_text: Appendices analyse tracking and truncation errors of the paper approximation.
blocks.translation: 附录分析论文近似中的 tracking 与 truncation error。
